comparison.objective: Wire a door lamp through a junction-box hinge, clip its cord, connect it, and latch the door; the candidate instead calibrates and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Flexible-cord routing, plug insertion, clipping, and door latching versus concentric driver/wrench seating and counter-torque locking.
comparison.success_condition: Requires connected and clipped wiring to survive an open-close door test without pinching; candidate requires a retained 90° stop across three released actuation cycles.
comparison.reason: Functional cycling is shared, but this record tests deformable cable management and enclosure closure, not preserving an adjustment while tightening its jam nut.
